===/developers/model-capabilities/text/reasoning===
# Reasoning

> Such models, such as `grok-4.5`, requests with `"xhigh"` are treated as `"high"`.

```bash
curl https://api.x.ai/v1/responses -d '{"model": "grok-4.7", "reasoning": {"effort": "high"}}'
```

### Summary table

| Model | `reasoning` parameter | Behavior |
|---|---|---|
| `grok-4.7` | `reasoning.effort`: `"low"` / `"medium"` / `"high"` (default) / `"xhigh"` | Controls reasoning depth (cannot be disabled) |
| `grok-4.6` | `reasoning.effort`: `"low"` / `"medium"` / `"high"` (default) / `"xhigh"` | Controls reasoning depth (cannot be disabled) |
| `grok-4.5` | `reasoning.effort`: `"low"` / `"medium"` / `"high"` (default) | Controls reasoning depth (cannot be disabled) |

===/developers/advanced-api-usage/watermarking===
# Output Watermarking

## Which outputs are watermarked

* grok-4.7
* grok-4.6
* grok-4.5

Watermarking applies to outputs from every text generation API, including the Responses API and the Chat Completions API.
